story.title: Delhi HC to Rule on Whether Indian Government Bypassed Tender Process for National Emergency Alert System
story.summary: The Delhi High Court is set to rule on whether the Indian government bypassed a competitive tender process when awarding the contract for India's national emergency alert system to state-run CDOT, following a petition filed by Germany-based Utimaco. The case raises fundamental questions about procurement transparency and whether a monopoly arrangement for critical public safety infrastructure is legally defensible. An urgent hearing has been triggered, indicating the court views the matter as time-sensitive given the system's role in national emergency communications.
